title: American Yeasty Biscuits with Basil Wok-Hei
description: These flaky American biscuits feature a yeasty, savory flavor profile with fresh basil leaves and a hint of wok-hei, perfect for a sick-day comfort food.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast and warm non-dairy milk. Stir to dissolve and let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and flaky sea salt. Whisk to combine.
Add canola oil and vegan butter to dry ingredients. Using a pastry blender or fork, cut until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add yeast mixture to dry ingredients. Mix until dough comes together in a shaggy mass.
Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead 6-8 times until smooth.
Roll dough out to 1-inch thickness. Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out biscuits.
Place biscuits on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush tops with a little extra non-dairy milk.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
Remove biscuits from oven and sprinkle with chopped basil leaves. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
